Ishøj is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatments across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) to benchmark local healthcare quality [^src1]. 

Ishøj is specifically noted for its data concerning stroke (*apopleksi*) events among atrial fibrillation patients, which feeds into the calculations for Indicator 5 (the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment) [^src1]. In the report's detailed municipal breakdown on page 93, Ishøj's performance metrics are listed in a data row as "Ishøj Ja # / # 0 (0) 0,6 (0,1-2,0) 8 / 370 2,2 1,4" [^src1]. Because the source document only references Ishøj within this single tabular entry, no further relationships, claims, or chronological events are available in the current corpus.
